This is a where-to-stay AREA GUIDE, not a ranked 'Best X' consensus guide, so the article carries no 'Cited by N sources' lines or numeric scores - the consensus/evidence work here is for choosing which hotels are actually backed by independent sources, per the consensus-guide skill's sourcing method, not for printing counts on the page.

scope.area: Bloomsbury, WC1 - bounded roughly by Euston Road (north), Southampton Row/Kingsway (east), New Oxford Street/Holborn (south) and Tottenham Court Road (west). Gower Street and Cartwright Gardens sit on the western edge, shading into Fitzrovia; Montague Street and Russell Square sit centrally; the Holborn/Bloomsbury boundary near the Hoxton and Rosewood is fuzzy and both guides already claim those hotels.
scope.mustCover: Every price tier the task specified: hostel/capsule beds, budget private rooms, mid-range, upmarket. Plus a short 'just outside' section (Fitzrovia, Holborn, a pointer to the King's Cross guide) - not a full second guide.
scope.mustNotRepeat: bloomsbury-area-guide.md's 'Where to stay' section (3 bullets, no hotel detail), the Bloomsbury paragraph in where-to-stay-kings-cross.md (Generator London + Zedwell TCR, written from a Eurostar-timing angle), and the Bloomsbury section in best-areas-to-stay-in-london.md (same two hotels, written from a citywide-comparison angle). This guide covers Generator and Zedwell too - they are genuinely the right hostel and windowless picks - but with fresh facts and prose, not the same sentences, and it is the page those two sections now link to for the full picture.
boundaryNotes: Generator London's own site files the property under 'Generator London King's Cross' (staygenerator.com/hostels/london shows it grouped with 'London King's Cross', not a Bloomsbury heading) even though its address (37 Tavistock Place, WC1H 9SE) and every third-party source call it Bloomsbury. Worth a line - it is genuinely on the boundary.
Arosfa Hotel's own site puts its Gower Street address under 'Fitzrovia, London WC1E 6HJ' in its footer, while Top Tip London and EuroCheapo both call it Bloomsbury. Same boundary, opposite hotel.

Rosewood London and SACO Holborn (already in the sheet, guide: covent-garden-area-guide) sit on the Bloomsbury/Holborn line; not featured here to avoid double-claiming, but worth a 'just outside' mention with a link to the Covent Garden guide.
